XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 3. What action is the Cabinet Minister taking to mark Baby Loss Awareness Week? OQ64635

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Deputy Minister for Social Care, Mental Health and Women’s Health
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Y Dirprwy Weinidog Gofal Cymdeithasol, Iechyd Meddwl ac Iechyd Menywod
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Art. Baby Loss Awareness Week is a really important opportunity to remember much-loved babies and to recognise the experiences of bereaved families. Alongside ongoing actions to improve support for families, plans are in place for the illumination of the Welsh Government building in Cardiff for the wave of light on 15 October.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Art. Mae Wythnos Ymwybyddiaeth Colli Babanod yn gyfle pwysig iawn i gofio babanod annwyl ac i gydnabod profiadau teuluoedd mewn profedigaeth. Ochr yn ochr â chamau gweithredu parhaus i wella cefnogaeth i deuluoedd, mae cynlluniau ar waith i oleuo adeilad Llywodraeth Cymru yng Nghaerdydd ar gyfer y don o olau ar 15 Hydref.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Cabinet Minister, one in two of us, or someone we know, has experienced pregnancy or baby loss. During Baby Loss Awareness Week, from 9 October to 15 October, we remember babies' lives, including those lost before 24 weeks. From April 2027, these parents will be entitled to two weeks of unpaid leave, yet some families still face choosing between time to grieve and paying the bills. These are the words from a bereaved parent: 'Many of us share our experiences as bereaved families because we want things to be better for others. We often know where things were missed and how care could be improved, but many of us struggle to be heard. We're told our experience matters, but it can be hard to find a way to share it with those who can make a difference. Our experiences and those of our babies are an important part of the understanding of what needs to change for other families.'

Following 'The path to safer beginnings in Wales' report, will the Minister commit to ensuring bereaved parents' voices are included in the work of the national oversight board, and will she urge employers to go beyond legal minimums in these traumatic circumstances?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Weinidog Cabinet, mae un o bob dau ohonom, neu rywun rydym yn eu hadnabod, wedi colli babi neu golli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd. Yn ystod Wythnos Ymwybyddiaeth Colli Babanod, o 9 Hydref i 15 Hydref, rydym yn cofio bywydau babanod, gan gynnwys y rhai a gollwyd cyn 24 wythnos. O fis Ebrill 2027, bydd gan y rhieni hyn hawl i bythefnos o absenoldeb di-dâl, ond mae rhai teuluoedd yn dal i wynebu dewis rhwng amser i alaru a thalu'r biliau. Dyma eiriau rhiant sydd wedi colli plentyn: 'Mae llawer ohonom yn rhannu ein profiadau fel teuluoedd sydd wedi colli plentyn gan ein bod eisiau i bethau fod yn well i eraill. Yn aml, gwyddom ble cafodd pethau eu methu a sut y gellid gwella gofal, ond mae llawer ohonom yn ei chael hi'n anodd cael ein clywed. Dywedir wrthym fod ein profiadau'n bwysig, ond gall fod yn anodd dod o hyd i ffordd i'w rhannu gyda'r rhai a all wneud gwahaniaeth. Mae ein profiadau ni a phrofiadau ein babanod yn rhan bwysig o'r ddealltwriaeth o'r hyn sydd angen newid i deuluoedd eraill.'

Yn dilyn adroddiad 'Y llwybr tuag at ddechrau mwy diogel yng Nghymru', a wnaiff y Gweinidog ymrwymo i sicrhau bod lleisiau rhieni sydd wedi colli plentyn yn cael eu cynnwys yng ngwaith y bwrdd trosolwg cenedlaethol, ac a wnaiff hi annog cyflogwyr i fynd y tu hwnt i'r gofynion cyfreithiol yn yr amgylchiadau trawmatig hyn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Art. I'm really grateful that you've raised this seriously significant issue. And in terms of the specific point that you made there, I know that there are some of these areas that would be in Westminster Government control, some in Welsh Government control, but anything that we can do to encourage that to happen, absolutely, I would be supportive of that.

I cannot begin to imagine the pain a mother or father goes through when they lose a baby. Baby Loss Awareness Week is a very timely moment for each of us to remember the hidden grief that too many parents carry beneath the surface of their daily lives: the loss that doesn't lessen with time, the birthdays or due dates that they will mark each year, the little lives that didn't start, but have stayed with them every day since they lost them. We cannot know the grief another person goes through. We owe it to those parents that their babies are remembered.

The Member has talked about needing to work with bereaved families. I support that idea intrinsically. I've held several meetings with Sands and with bereaved families, and I am determined to keep working with them to ensure that bereaved families help to shape what we do in this area. Nothing—nothing—can lessen the loss that they have suffered, but they want to fight to make things better for other families in the future. And my God, I want to help them to do that.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Art. Rwy'n ddiolchgar iawn eich bod wedi codi'r mater arwyddocaol iawn hwn. Ac o ran y pwynt penodol a wnaethoch yno, gwn y byddai rhai o'r meysydd hyn o dan reolaeth Llywodraeth San Steffan a rhai o dan reolaeth Llywodraeth Cymru, ond unrhyw beth y gallwn ei wneud i annog hynny i ddigwydd, yn bendant, byddwn yn cefnogi hynny.

Ni allaf ddechrau dychmygu'r boen y mae mam neu dad yn ei phrofi pan fyddant yn colli babi. Mae Wythnos Ymwybyddiaeth Colli Babanod yn foment amserol iawn i bob un ohonom gofio'r galar cudd y mae gormod o rieni yn byw gydag ef o dan wyneb eu bywydau bob dydd: y golled nad yw'n lleihau gydag amser, y penblwyddi neu'r dyddiadau geni disgwyliedig y byddant yn eu nodi bob blwyddyn, y bywydau bach na ddechreuodd, ond sydd wedi aros gyda nhw bob dydd ers eu colli. Ni allwn ddirnad y galar y mae unigolyn arall yn ei brofi. Ein dyletswydd i'r rhieni hynny yw gwneud yn siŵr bod eu babanod yn cael eu cofio.

Mae'r Aelod wedi sôn am yr angen i weithio gyda theuluoedd mewn profedigaeth. Rwy'n cefnogi'r syniad hwnnw'n llwyr. Rwyf wedi cynnal sawl cyfarfod gyda Sands a theuluoedd mewn profedigaeth, ac rwy'n benderfynol o barhau i weithio gyda nhw i sicrhau bod teuluoedd mewn profedigaeth yn helpu i siapio'r hyn a wnawn yn y maes hwn. Ni all unrhyw beth—unrhyw beth—leihau'r golled y maent wedi'i dioddef, ond maent eisiau ymladd i wneud pethau'n well i deuluoedd eraill yn y dyfodol. Ac rwy'n bendant eisiau eu helpu i wneud hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'd like to associate myself with the comments that have already been made by the Member who tabled this question, and to go back to that issue that, from April, women and partners who have any type of pregnancy loss will be entitled to that two-week leave period under those major changes announced by the UK Labour Government's Department for Business and Trade, whereas at present, of course, there is no statutory right if the loss happens before 24 weeks. The devastation of pregnancy loss isn't defined by the calendar, so it is sensible and necessary to have these changes. I note the range of interventions that you, Deputy Minister, announced when responding to June's Members' debate on baby loss. But what I'd really like to ask you on this particular issue is: what steps will the Welsh Government take to ensure that people affected by pregnancy loss are aware of these new leave entitlements when the changes take effect?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Hoffwn gytuno â'r sylwadau sydd eisoes wedi'u gwneud gan yr Aelod a gyflwynodd y cwestiwn hwn, ac i fynd yn ôl at y mater hwnnw, o fis Ebrill ymlaen, bydd menywod a phartneriaid sydd wedi colli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd mewn unrhyw ffordd yn gymwys i gael y cyfnod absenoldeb hwnnw o bythefnos o dan y newidiadau mawr a gyhoeddwyd gan Adran Fusnes a Masnach Llywodraeth Lafur y DU, gan nad oes hawl statudol ar hyn o bryd wrth gwrs, os yw'r golled yn digwydd cyn 24 wythnos. Nid yw dinistr colli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd wedi'i ddiffinio gan y calendr, felly mae'r newidiadau hyn yn synhwyrol ac yn angenrheidiol. Nodaf yr ystod o ymyriadau a gyhoeddwyd gennych, Ddirprwy Weinidog, wrth ymateb i ddadl yr Aelodau ym mis Mehefin ar golli babanod. Ond yr hyn yr hoffwn ei ofyn i chi ynglŷn â'r mater penodol hwn yw: pa gamau y bydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn eu cymryd i sicrhau bod pobl sy'n colli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd yn ymwybodol o'r hawliau absenoldeb newydd hyn pan ddaw'r newidiadau i rym?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Vikki. That's also a really timely and important question, and I agree utterly with what you said there, that the devastation and grief that a parent, a family, goes through can never be defined by something arbitrary like a calendar.

I think that there are many ways in which we can ensure, whether that is—. I'd be interested to see what we can do in terms of signs, and things like that, in areas of hospital wards. But I think that's a really important challenge, actually, and I'd like to go away and think a bit more about how we can use every possible opportunity to ensure that families know that that is there. Because there's no point in it being there if—. This theme comes up very often in the Chamber. If people don't know it's available, then what on earth is the point of it being there in the first place? I'll take that challenge. Thank you for raising that to see how we can use every opportunity to make sure families know about it. Diolch, Vikki.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Vikki. Mae hwnnw hefyd yn gwestiwn amserol a phwysig iawn, a chytunaf yn llwyr â'r hyn a ddywedoch chi, na ellir byth ddiffinio'r dinistr a'r galar y mae rhiant, teulu, yn mynd drwyddo yn ôl rhywbeth mor fympwyol â chalendr.

Rwy'n credu bod yna lawer o ffyrdd y gallwn sicrhau, boed hynny—. Byddai gennyf ddiddordeb mewn gweld beth y gallwn ei wneud o ran arwyddion ac ati ar wardiau ysbytai. Ond rwy'n credu bod honno'n her bwysig iawn, mewn gwirionedd, a hoffwn feddwl mwy ynglŷn â sut y gallwn ddefnyddio pob cyfle posibl i sicrhau bod teuluoedd yn gwybod bod hynny ar gael. Oherwydd nid oes pwynt iddo fod yno os—. Mae'r thema hon yn codi'n aml iawn yn y Siambr. Os nad yw pobl yn gwybod ei fod ar gael, beth ar y ddaear yw pwynt ei gael yno yn y lle cyntaf? Rwy'n derbyn yr her honno. Diolch am godi hynny i weld sut y gallwn ddefnyddio pob cyfle i sicrhau bod teuluoedd yn gwybod amdano. Diolch, Vikki.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dwi'n moyn rhoi ar y cofnod fy mod i'n estyn fy nghariad tuag at unrhyw riant neu deulu estynedig sydd wedi delio â hwn. Wythnos diwethaf, mynychais uwch-gynhadledd Colli Babi a Thu Hwnt yma yn y Senedd, a drefnwyd gan Better Maternity Cymru. Hoffwn gydnabod yr ymgyrchwyr, yr elusennau a'r bydwragedd profedigaeth a oedd yn bresennol o fy etholaeth fy hun, gan gynnwys Danika o William's Embrace, Jade o Sefydliad Mitchell a Ruth o Sands Merthyr. Mae llawer ohonynt yn rhieni mewn profedigaeth eu hunain ac yn defnyddio eu profiad personol a'u harbenigedd i wella'r gofal a ddarperir i deuluoedd eraill.

Rwy'n croesawu ymrwymiad y Gweinidog i wella gofal mamolaeth a gofal profedigaeth, a'n huchelgais ar y cyd i sicrhau bod teuluoedd yn cael y cymorth sydd ei angen arnynt. Wrth wrando ar rieni a gweithwyr proffesiynol, daeth yn amlwg pa mor bwysig yw sicrhau bod gan y rhai sy'n cefnogi teuluoedd yr adnoddau sydd eu hangen i barhau â'r gwaith hwn. Mae bydwragedd profedigaeth yn darparu gofal arbenigol hanfodol a chymorth parhaus, ond lle mae'r gwaith hwn yn gyfrifoldeb ar un unigolyn neu ddau unigolyn yn rhannu'r un swydd, mae capasiti yn gyfyngedig.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I'd like to put on record that I am sending my love to any parent or family member who have dealt with this. Last week, I attended the Babyloss and Beyond summit here in the Senedd, organised by Better Maternity Cymru. I'd like to recognise the campaigners, the charities and bereavement midwives who attended from my own constituency, including Danika from William's Embrace, Jade from the Mitchell Foundation and Ruth from Merthyr Sands. Many of them are bereaved parents themselves and use their personal experience and expertise to improve the care provided to other families.

I welcome the Minister's commitment to improving maternity care and bereavement care, and our shared ambition to ensure that families receive the support they need. While listening to parents and professionals, it became clear how important it is to ensure that those who support families have the resources that they need to continue with this work. Bereavement midwives provide essential specialist care and ongoing support, but in cases where this work is the responsibility of one individual or two individuals sharing one job, capacity is limited.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Allwn ni gael y cwestiwn, plis? Sori.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Could we have the question, please? Sorry.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wrth gwrs. A all y Gweinidog nodi sut y bydd y Llywodraeth yn sicrhau bod pob bwrdd iechyd yn darparu cymorth profedigaeth cyson o ansawdd uchel, gan sicrhau lefelau staffio a chapasiti bydwragedd profedigaeth safonol, fel bod pob teulu yn cael profiad cyson o'r un safon ym mhob cwr o Gymru? Diolch yn fawr. Sori am fynd dros amser.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Of course. Can the Minister set out how the Government will ensure that all health boards provide consistent bereavement support of high quality, ensuring standard staffing levels and bereavement midwife capacity, so that families have a consistent experience of the same standard of care in all parts of Wales? Thank you very much. Sorry for going over time.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am hwnna, Sara, ac ymddiheuriadau unwaith eto fy mod i'n gorfod cael fy nghefn tuag atoch chi pan dwi'n eich ateb chi. Fel roedd Sara'n dweud, byddwn i eisiau estyn fy nghariad innau hefyd at y rhieni hynny sydd yn gwylio, ac i ddiolch i drefnwyr nid yn unig y digwyddiad mae Sara wedi sôn amdano, ond trefnwyr digwyddiadau dros Gymru sydd yn digwydd ac sy'n rhoi cymaint o gefnogaeth i rieni sydd yn dioddef.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for that, Sara, and apologies that I have to have my back to you when I'm responding to you. As Sara said, I would like to extend my love to those families who are watching, and to thank the organisers not only of the event that Sara mentioned, but also events across Wales that are happening and that provide so much support to bereaved parents.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Every family who face pregnancy and baby loss has to have that support that is compassionate, that is consistent no matter where they live, as the Member has alluded to. The 'National bereavement care pathway' that we've published set out the standards of care that families should receive across Wales, and there are pathways on sudden and unexpected death, on children and young people, on pregnancy and baby loss, and they are there with the aim to support a more consistent approach across the country. We're working with health boards, NHS Wales and Sands to support how that is rolled out and to monitor how it is delivered. Every health board has a named bereavement lead in place, and, again, we are continuing to work with the NHS, local authorities and the third sector to strengthen those bereavement services and to make sure that there is not variation. Families have to receive the care that they need, and I know that that need doesn't go away when someone leaves hospital. The journey of grief is one that they will be on throughout their lives, and we owe it to them to walk with them when they tread that difficult path.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae angen i bob teulu sy'n wynebu colli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd neu golli babi gael cymorth sy'n dangos tosturi ac yn gyson ble bynnag y maent yn byw, fel y nododd yr Aelod. Mae'r 'Llwybr gofal profedigaeth cenedlaethol' a gyhoeddwyd gennym yn nodi'r safonau gofal y dylai teuluoedd eu cael ledled Cymru, ac maent yn cynnwys llwybrau ar farwolaeth sydyn ac annisgwyl, ar blant a phobl ifanc, ar golli babi yn ystod beichiogrwydd a cholli babi, ac mae'r rhain yno i hyrwyddo mwy o gysondeb ledled y wlad. Rydym yn gweithio gyda byrddau iechyd, GIG Cymru a'r Gymdeithas Marw-enedigaethau a Marwolaethau Newyddanedigion, Sands, i gefnogi'r broses o'u cyflwyno ac i fonitro sut y cânt eu gweithredu. Bellach, mae gan bob bwrdd iechyd arweinydd wedi'i enwi ar gyfer materion profedigaeth, ac rydym yn parhau i gydweithio â'r GIG, awdurdodau lleol a'r trydydd sector i gryfhau'r gwasanaethau profedigaeth hynny ac i sicrhau nad oes amrywiadau. Rhaid i deuluoedd gael y gofal sydd ei angen arnynt, ac rwy'n gwybod nad yw'r angen hwnnw'n diflannu pan fydd rhywun yn gadael yr ysbyty. Mae taith galar yn un y byddant arni trwy gydol eu bywydau, ac mae'n ddyletswydd arnom i gyd-gerdded gyda nhw wrth iddynt droedio'r llwybr anodd hwnnw.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 4. A wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet amlinellu cynlluniau Llywodraeth Cymru ar gyfer mynd i'r afael â chlefydau cardiofasgwlaidd yn Afan Ogwr Rhondda? OQ64659
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. Will the Cabinet Minister outline the Welsh Government's plans for tackling cardiovascular diseases in Afan Ogwr Rhondda? OQ64659

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Our programme for government commits to prioritising the prevention of ill health through a cross-Government approach and development of a public health strategy. It also includes a commitment to strengthen national clinical pathways for cardiovascular care, ensuring equitable access to high-quality, person-centred services, reducing unwarranted variation and improving outcomes and experiences.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae ein rhaglen lywodraethu yn ymrwymo i flaenoriaethu atal salwch drwy ddull trawslywodraethol a datblygu strategaeth iechyd y cyhoedd. Mae hefyd yn cynnwys ymrwymiad i gryfhau llwybrau clinigol cenedlaethol ar gyfer gofal cardiofasgwlaidd, gan sicrhau mynediad teg at wasanaethau o ansawdd uchel sy'n canolbwyntio ar yr unigolyn, yn lleihau amrywiad na ellir ei gyfiawnhau, ac yn gwella canlyniadau a phrofiadau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Weinidog. I recently met with the British Heart Foundation Cymru, and they estimate that cardiovascular disease costs the Welsh economy in the region of £1.7 billion a year. With around 27,000 people in Afan Ogwr Rhondda living with cardiovascular disease, effective national clinical leadership is key to ensuring they receive consistent, high-quality care.

In March, the previous Government confirmed that the national clinical lead role for cardiology would be advertised, and recruitment opened in April for a two-year secondment. However, the cardiac implementation network's website still lists its national clinical lead and several other clinical roles as vacant. What steps is the Government taking to ensure that the cardiac implementation network has the clinical leadership it needs to deliver the quality statement for heart conditions?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Weinidog. Yn ddiweddar, cyfarfûm â British Heart Foundation Cymru, ac maent yn amcangyfrif bod clefyd cardiofasgwlaidd yn costio tua £1.7 biliwn y flwyddyn i economi Cymru. Gyda thua 27,000 o bobl yn Afan Ogwr Rhondda yn byw gyda chlefyd cardiofasgwlaidd, mae arweinyddiaeth glinigol genedlaethol effeithiol yn allweddol i sicrhau eu bod yn cael gofal cyson o ansawdd uchel.

Ym mis Mawrth, cadarnhaodd y Llywodraeth flaenorol y byddai rôl arweinydd clinigol cenedlaethol ar gyfer cardioleg yn cael ei hysbysebu, ac agorwyd y broses recriwtio ym mis Ebrill ar gyfer secondiad dwy flynedd. Fodd bynnag, mae gwefan y rhwydwaith gweithredu ar gyfer gofal y galon yn dal i restru ei swydd arweinydd clinigol cenedlaethol a nifer o rolau clinigol eraill fel rhai gwag. Pa gamau y mae'r Llywodraeth yn eu cymryd i sicrhau bod gan y rhwydwaith gweithredu ar gyfer gofal y galon yr arweinyddiaeth glinigol sydd ei hangen arno i gyflawni'r datganiad ansawdd ar gyfer cyflyrau’r galon?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. Dirprwy Lywydd, I'm not sure if I should declare an interest: I used to be a staff member for the British Heart Foundation many years ago, since the Member referenced the British Heart Foundation in his question.

But, on to the substantive point, I recognise the important contribution that national clinical networks make in supporting NHS service improvement. NHS Wales Performance and Improvement is reviewing the clinical leadership model for all national clinical networks, including the cardiac implementation network. The review is focused on determining the most effective clinical leadership arrangements to support the transformation of clinical services in Wales and is due to complete in December of this year. While this review is under way, NHSPI sought to make temporary appointments to clinical leadership roles in the cardiac network, but was, sadly, unable to make an appointment. In the meantime, NHSPI is providing support from its senior executive team, including the medical director, in relation to the work plan of the cardiac implementation network.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Ddirprwy Lywydd, nid wyf yn siŵr a ddylwn ddatgan buddiant: roeddwn i'n arfer bod yn aelod o staff y British Heart Foundation flynyddoedd lawer yn ôl, gan fod yr Aelod wedi cyfeirio at y British Heart Foundation yn ei gwestiwn.

Ond ar y prif bwynt, rwy'n cydnabod y cyfraniad pwysig y mae rhwydweithiau clinigol cenedlaethol yn ei wneud yn cefnogi’r broses o wella gwasanaethau'r GIG. Mae Perfformiad a Gwella GIG Cymru yn adolygu'r model arweinyddiaeth glinigol ar gyfer pob rhwydwaith clinigol cenedlaethol, gan gynnwys y rhwydwaith gweithredu ar gyfer gofal y galon. Mae'r adolygiad yn canolbwyntio ar bennu'r trefniadau arweinyddiaeth glinigol mwyaf effeithiol i gefnogi trawsnewidiad gwasanaethau clinigol yng Nghymru, ac mae disgwyl iddo gael ei gwblhau ym mis Rhagfyr eleni. Tra bod yr adolygiad hwn ar y gweill, ceisiodd Perfformiad a Gwella GIG Cymru wneud penodiadau dros dro i rolau arweinyddiaeth glinigol yn y rhwydwaith cardiaidd, ond yn anffodus, ni lwyddwyd i wneud penodiad. Yn y cyfamser, mae Perfformiad a Gwella GIG Cymru yn darparu cymorth gan ei dîm gweithredol uwch, gan gynnwys y cyfarwyddwr meddygol, mewn perthynas â chynllun gwaith y rhwydwaith gweithredu ar gyfer gofal y galon.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'd like to declare an interest, as my partner works within the NHS.

Cabinet Minister, in Afan Ogwr Rhondda, around 27,000 people are living with cardiovascular disease, and it causes more than one in four deaths—around 630 people every year. More than 36,000 people are living with diagnosed high blood pressure, one of the biggest risk factors for heart attacks and strokes. Your programme for government commits to strengthening cardiovascular care and reducing regional variation. My constituency is served by both Cwm Taf Morgannwg University Health Board and Swansea Bay University Health Board, so reducing regional variation matters directly here. We do not need another plan for its own sake; we need action that reduces preventable heart attacks, strokes and premature deaths. So, by 31 March 2027, will you set both health boards a published, measurable target to increase the proportion of patients with high blood pressure whose condition is under control—yes or no? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Hoffwn ddatgan buddiant, gan fod fy mhartner yn gweithio yn y GIG.

Weinidog Cabinet, yn Afan Ogwr Rhondda, mae tua 27,000 o bobl yn byw gyda chlefyd cardiofasgwlaidd, a dyna sy’n achosi mwy nag un ym mhob pedair marwolaeth—tua 630 o bobl bob blwyddyn. Mae mwy na 36,000 o bobl yn byw gyda diagnosis o bwysedd gwaed uchel, un o'r ffactorau risg mwyaf ar gyfer trawiadau ar y galon a strôc. Mae eich rhaglen lywodraethu yn ymrwymo i gryfhau gofal cardiofasgwlaidd a lleihau amrywiad rhanbarthol. Mae fy etholaeth yn cael ei gwasanaethu gan Fwrdd Iechyd Prifysgol Cwm Taf Morgannwg a Bwrdd Iechyd Prifysgol Bae Abertawe, felly mae lleihau amrywiad rhanbarthol yn uniongyrchol berthnasol yma. Nid cynllun arall sydd ei angen arnom, ond gweithredu i leihau trawiadau ar y galon, strôc a marwolaethau cynamserol y gellir eu hatal. Felly, erbyn 31 Mawrth 2027, a wnewch chi gyhoeddi targed mesuradwy i'r ddau fwrdd iechyd i gynyddu cyfran y cleifion â phwysedd gwaed uchel y mae eu cyflwr dan reolaeth—gwnewch neu na wnewch? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: It's probably important to set out that I don't set, as Minister, targets for each individual health board; it's the health boards themselves that deliver clinically in their areas, so it's up to them to deliver based on their ability to do so. But you do make a very important point about the regional differences that we've got in Wales; that someone can live in one part of Wales and expect a different service and, indeed, a different outcome to someone in another part of Wales. That's why one of our ambitions and one of our priorities in this Government is to tear down those regional barriers that are stopping organisations from working together. I and my colleagues—both Deputy Ministers—attended a Welsh NHS Confederation meeting yesterday with the chairs and chief executives of the health boards and trusts across Wales, and we were discussing this exact point of how we can make sure that they work together better, so that they serve the people of Wales and have a one-Wales approach to delivering services.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'n siŵr ei bod hi'n bwysig nodi nad wyf i, fel Gweinidog, yn pennu targedau ar gyfer pob bwrdd iechyd unigol; y byrddau iechyd eu hunain sy'n cyflawni’n glinigol yn eu hardaloedd, felly mater iddynt hwy yw cyflawni hynny yn seiliedig ar eu gallu i wneud hynny. Ond rydych chi'n gwneud pwynt pwysig iawn ynghylch y gwahaniaethau rhanbarthol sydd gennym yng Nghymru; fod rhywun yn gallu byw mewn un rhan o Gymru a disgwyl gwasanaeth gwahanol, a chanlyniad gwahanol yn wir, i rywun mewn rhan arall o Gymru. Dyna pam mai un o'n huchelgeisiau ac un o'n blaenoriaethau yn y Llywodraeth hon yw chwalu'r rhwystrau rhanbarthol sy'n atal sefydliadau rhag gweithio gyda'i gilydd. Roeddwn i a fy nghyd-Aelodau—y ddau Ddirprwy Weinidog—yn bresennol mewn cyfarfod o Gydffederasiwn y GIG ddoe gyda chadeiryddion a phrif weithredwyr y byrddau iechyd a'r ymddiriedolaethau ledled Cymru, ac roeddem yn trafod yr union bwynt hwn ynglŷn â sut y gallwn sicrhau eu bod yn gweithio gyda'i gilydd yn well er mwyn gwasanaethu pobl Cymru a mabwysiadu dull Cymru gyfan o ddarparu gwasanaethau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 5. What action is the Cabinet Minister taking to improve communication between NHS organisations and patients in Pen-y-bont Bro Morgannwg and more widely across Wales? OQ64657

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Patients deserve clear, timely and compassionate communication throughout their care. We are strengthening accountability for patient experience, improving how NHS bodies share information and expanding the NHS Wales app and joined-up records so that people can access appointments, waiting list information and care details more easily.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae cleifion yn haeddu cyfathrebu clir, amserol a thosturiol trwy gydol eu gofal. Rydym yn cryfhau atebolrwydd am brofiad cleifion, yn gwella sut y mae cyrff y GIG yn rhannu gwybodaeth ac yn ehangu ap GIG Cymru a chofnodion cydgysylltiedig fel y gall pobl gael mynediad at apwyntiadau, gwybodaeth am restrau aros a manylion gofal yn haws.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Weinidog. Patients in Pen-y-bont Bro Morgannwg tell me that they are left chasing health boards for basic information about appointments, waiting lists and treatment plans, and are sometimes given conflicting information by different parts of the NHS. Poor communication isn't limited to patients and service providers. In a recent case that I dealt with, a cancer patient was referred by their health board, Cwm Taf Morgannwg, to Swansea bay to receive a biopsy. When concerns were raised about delays in receiving their results, neither health board took any accountability to provide the update.

Does the Cabinet Minister accept that this is not simply an inconvenience, but an unacceptable failure of patient care? What action can be taken to ensure that patients are kept properly informed throughout their treatment journey?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Weinidog. Mae cleifion ym Mhen-y-bont Bro Morgannwg yn dweud wrthyf eu bod yn gorfod mynd ar ôl y byrddau iechyd i gael gwybodaeth sylfaenol am apwyntiadau, rhestrau aros a chynlluniau triniaeth, ac weithiau'n cael gwybodaeth wahanol gan wahanol rannau o'r GIG. Nid yw cyfathrebu gwael yn gyfyngedig i gleifion a darparwyr gwasanaeth. Mewn achos diweddar y deliais ag ef, cafodd claf canser ei atgyfeirio gan eu bwrdd iechyd, Cwm Taf Morgannwg, i fae Abertawe i gael biopsi. Pan godwyd pryderon ynghylch oedi cyn cael eu canlyniadau, ni chymerodd y naill fwrdd iechyd na'r llall unrhyw gyfrifoldeb dros ddarparu'r diweddariad.

A yw'r Gweinidog Cabinet yn derbyn nad anghyfleustra'n unig yw hyn, ond methiant annerbyniol o ran gofal cleifion? Pa gamau y gellir eu cymryd i sicrhau bod cleifion yn cael eu hysbysu'n briodol trwy gydol eu triniaeth?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dirprwy Lywydd, I agree that this is more than just a simple inconvenience. When patients are awaiting a diagnosis or a treatment, poor communication can add significant distress and uncertainty. Patients shouldn't be passed between organisations to obtain information about their own care. Where services are shared, NHS organisations must take collective responsibility for keeping patients informed and ensuring that communication is clear, timely and joined up. That's why we are improving information sharing, expanding digital access through the NHS Wales app, and holding NHS organisations accountable for the experience that patients receive throughout their care journey. On cancer, we are developing a new cancer strategy that is looking exactly at this, and I was speaking about this point earlier today with Macmillan, looking at ways of improving the communication between the acute setting, the primary care setting and the patient, in ensuring an improved whole-cancer-pathway experience.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ddirprwy Lywydd, rwy'n cytuno bod hyn yn fwy nag anghyfleustra. Pan fydd cleifion yn aros am ddiagnosis neu driniaeth, gall cyfathrebu gwael ychwanegu trallod ac ansicrwydd sylweddol. Ni ddylid trosglwyddo cleifion rhwng sefydliadau i gael gwybodaeth am eu gofal. Pan fydd gwasanaethau'n cael eu rhannu, rhaid i sefydliadau'r GIG gymryd cyfrifoldeb ar y cyd am roi gwybodaeth i gleifion a sicrhau bod cyfathrebu'n glir, yn amserol ac yn gydgysylltiedig. Dyna pam ein bod yn gwella prosesau rhannu gwybodaeth, yn ehangu mynediad digidol trwy ap GIG Cymru, ac yn dwyn sefydliadau'r GIG i gyfrif am y profiad y mae cleifion yn ei gael drwy gydol eu gofal. Ar ganser, rydym yn datblygu strategaeth ganser newydd sy'n edrych yn benodol ar hyn, ac roeddwn i'n siarad am y pwynt hwn yn gynharach heddiw gyda Macmillan, gan edrych ar ffyrdd o wella cyfathrebu rhwng y lleoliad acíwt, y lleoliad gofal sylfaenol a'r claf, er mwyn sicrhau gwell profiad ar hyd y llwybr canser cyfan.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Decarbonising the Health and Care Sector

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. What action has the Government taken to decarbonise the health and care sector? OQ64662

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We are taking clear action to decarbonise the health and care system and strengthen climate resilience. The 'NHS Wales decarbonisation strategic delivery plan' and 'Decarbonising Social Care in Wales' set out how the sector will contribute to Wales's statutory net zero 2050 target, while protecting services and improving population health.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym yn gweithredu'n bendant i ddatgarboneiddio'r system iechyd a gofal a chryfhau gwydnwch hinsawdd. Mae 'Cynllun cyflenwi strategol datgarboneiddio GIG Cymru' a 'Datgarboneiddio Gofal Cymdeithasol yng Nghymru' yn nodi sut y bydd y sector yn cyfrannu at darged sero net statudol Cymru 2050, tra'n diogelu gwasanaethau a gwella iechyd y boblogaeth.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for that answer. More than 540,000 patients are on NHS waiting lists in Wales. Behind those figures are people in pain, families living with uncertainty, and patients waiting desperately for the treatment that they need. The public sector decarbonisation programme is a staggering £38.7 million, plus £40 million targeted at the NHS. Based on average Welsh salaries, that money could employ nurses, doctors, surgeons and not forgetting those students coming out of university who still cannot get jobs. I'm not suggesting that we ignore the environment, but when our hospitals are struggling, waiting lists are growing and front-line staff are under immense pressure, we must ask whether taxpayers' money is being spent on the right priorities.

Will the Government review its climate-related NHS spending and redirect funding, wherever possible, towards clearing waiting lists and recruiting more front-line staff that our health service desperately needs? Because patients waiting in pain deserve more than targets and promises; they deserve treatment and they deserve a health service that puts their needs first. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am yr ateb hwnnw. Mae mwy na 540,000 o gleifion ar restrau aros y GIG yng Nghymru. Y tu ôl i'r ffigurau hynny mae pobl mewn poen, teuluoedd yn byw gydag ansicrwydd, a chleifion yn aros yn daer am y driniaeth sydd ei hangen arnynt. Mae rhaglen ddatgarboneiddio'r sector cyhoeddus yn costio'r ffigur syfrdanol o £38.7 miliwn, ynghyd â'r £40 miliwn a dargedwyd at y GIG. Yn seiliedig ar gyflogau cyfartalog Cymru, gallai'r arian hwnnw gyflogi nyrsys, meddygon, llawfeddygon, heb anghofio'r myfyrwyr sy'n dod allan o'r brifysgol ac sy'n dal i fethu cael swyddi. Nid wyf yn awgrymu ein bod yn anwybyddu'r amgylchedd, ond pan fydd ein hysbytai yn ei chael hi'n anodd, rhestrau aros yn cynyddu a staff rheng flaen o dan bwysau enfawr, rhaid inni ofyn a yw arian trethdalwyr yn cael ei wario ar y blaenoriaethau cywir.

A wnaiff y Llywodraeth adolygu ei gwariant GIG sy'n gysylltiedig â'r hinsawdd ac ailgyfeirio cyllid, lle bynnag y bo'n bosibl, tuag at glirio rhestrau aros a recriwtio mwy o'r staff rheng flaen sydd ei angen mor daer ar ein gwasanaeth iechyd? Oherwydd mae cleifion sy'n aros mewn poen yn haeddu mwy na thargedau ac addewidion; maent yn haeddu triniaeth ac maent yn haeddu gwasanaeth iechyd sy'n rhoi eu hanghenion nhw yn gyntaf. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for the question. I'm afraid looking at it from that lens is overly simplistic. That's tantamount to saying, 'Let's stop development in the estates, because we need to put more money into nursing, or more money into the clinical sector.' It's not that simple.

When we look at decarbonising the NHS, first of all, we have to accept that climate change is happening, and we have a duty to respond to that massive challenge. Climate change alone is leading to—we've seen it over the last summer—worse health outcomes for people in Wales. But decarbonising the NHS isn't just a matter of putting things on paper, or changing some ways of working; it's about improving the services. It's about making sure that we have services fit for the twenty-first century, that we have an estate fit for the twenty-first century, that we have equipment that is suitable for the modern challenges ahead. So, we won't stop the decarbonising project. It is part of ensuring that we have an NHS that is capable of answering the needs of modern times.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am y cwestiwn. Rwy'n ofni bod edrych arno drwy'r lens honno'n rhy syml. Mae'n gyfystyr â dweud, 'Gadewch inni roi'r gorau i ddatblygiadau yn yr ystadau am fod angen inni roi mwy o arian tuag at nyrsio, neu fwy o arian tuag at y sector clinigol.' Nid yw mor syml â hynny.

Pan edrychwn ar ddatgarboneiddio'r GIG, yn gyntaf oll, rhaid inni dderbyn bod newid hinsawdd yn digwydd, ac mae dyletswydd arnom i ymateb i'r her enfawr honno. Mae newid hinsawdd ynddo'i hun—fe'i gwelsom dros yr haf diwethaf—yn arwain at ganlyniadau iechyd gwaeth i bobl yng Nghymru. Ond nid mater o roi pethau ar bapur yn unig yw datgarboneiddio'r GIG, neu newid rhai ffyrdd o weithio; mae'n ymwneud â gwella'r gwasanaethau. Mae'n ymwneud â gwneud yn siŵr bod gennym wasanaethau sy'n addas ar gyfer yr unfed ganrif ar hugain, fod gennym ystad sy'n addas ar gyfer yr unfed ganrif ar hugain, fod gennym offer sy'n addas ar gyfer yr heriau modern sydd o'n blaenau. Felly, ni fyddwn yn rhoi'r gorau i'r prosiect datgarboneiddio. Mae'n rhan o sicrhau bod gennym GIG sy'n gallu ateb anghenion yr oes fodern.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dirprwy Lywydd, surgical hubs are central to our plans to reduce waiting times and improve access to planned care. We have committed £25 million capital funding to support the development of elective care, surgical and diagnostic hubs across Wales. An expert group will advise on future hub configuration and report later this year.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ddirprwy Lywydd, mae hybiau llawfeddygol yn ganolog i'n cynlluniau i leihau amseroedd aros a gwella mynediad at ofal a gynlluniwyd. Rydym wedi ymrwymo £25 miliwn o gyllid cyfalaf i gefnogi'r gwaith o ddatblygu hybiau gofal a gynlluniwyd, gofal llawfeddygol a diagnosteg ledled Cymru. Bydd grŵp arbenigol yn cynghori ar gyfluniad hybiau yn y dyfodol ac yn adrodd yn ôl yn ddiweddarach eleni.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you, Cabinet Minister. I've heard from my constituents in Sir Fynwy Torfaen of an average wait time of 73 weeks for routine appointments with the head or consultant of orthopaedics, and a 50-week wait for an out-patient appointment for standard dermatology referrals. So much of the pressure on the NHS waiting list comes from these routine procedures, so anything we can do to help with this can only be a good thing, making people's quality of life better, reducing the stress of long-term uncertainty for patients waiting for treatments and appointments, and improving the overall standard of the health service. 

Has the elective care task and finish group started its work on identifying the best locations for the 10 new surgical care hubs across Wales, so we can start tackling the inequality of access to routine care and take the pressure off waiting times?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Weinidog Cabinet. Clywais gan fy etholwyr yn Sir Fynwy Torfaen am amser aros cyfartalog o 73 wythnos ar gyfer apwyntiadau rheolaidd gyda'r prif feddyg ymgynghorol orthopaedig, a 50 wythnos o aros am apwyntiad cleifion allanol ar gyfer atgyfeiriadau dermatoleg safonol. Mae cymaint o'r pwysau ar restr aros y GIG yn deillio o'r llawdriniaethau rheolaidd hyn, felly gall unrhyw beth y gallwn ei wneud i helpu gyda hyn fod yn beth da, gan wella ansawdd bywyd pobl, lleihau'r straen o ansicrwydd hirdymor i gleifion sy'n aros am driniaethau ac apwyntiadau, a gwella safon gyffredinol y gwasanaeth iechyd.

A yw'r grŵp gorchwyl a gorffen ar ofal a gynlluniwyd wedi dechrau ei waith ar nodi'r lleoliadau gorau ar gyfer y 10 hyb gofal llawfeddygol newydd ledled Cymru, fel y gallwn ddechrau mynd i'r afael ag anghydraddoldeb mynediad at ofal rheolaidd a thynnu'r pwysau oddi ar amseroedd aros?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
The elective care expert group has started its work and is developing a delivery plan for up to 10 elective care hubs across Wales, with recommendations due by the end of 2026. The group is clinically led and brings together senior surgeons, nurses, anaesthetists and operational leaders. It will determine how many hubs are needed, where they should be based and how they can add the greatest capacity.

We're backing the programme with a £25 million capital investment. By separating planned surgery and diagnostics from emergency pressures, the hubs will increase capacity, reduce cancellations and help patients receive care sooner. We're already putting this approach into practice. The £121 million regional orthopaedic hub at Llantrisant will provide six theatres and 54 beds and is expected to deliver around 3,000 operations a year. Aneurin Bevan University Health Board is one of the three health boards working together on the project.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae'r grŵp arbenigol ar ofal a gynlluniwyd wedi dechrau ar ei waith ac yn datblygu cynllun cyflawni ar gyfer hyd at 10 hyb gofal a gynlluniwyd ledled Cymru, gydag argymhellion i'w cyflwyno erbyn diwedd 2026. Mae'r grŵp yn cael ei arwain yn glinigol ac yn dod â llawfeddygon uwch, nyrsys, anesthetyddion ac arweinwyr gweithredol ynghyd. Bydd yn penderfynu faint o hybiau sydd eu hangen, ble y dylid eu lleoli a sut y gallant ychwanegu'r capasiti mwyaf.

Rydym yn cefnogi'r rhaglen gyda buddsoddiad cyfalaf o £25 miliwn. Drwy wahanu llawdriniaethau a gynlluniwyd a diagnosteg oddi wrth bwysau gofal argyfwng, bydd yr hybiau'n cynyddu capasiti, yn lleihau nifer y llawdriniaethau a gaiff eu canslo ac yn helpu cleifion i gael gofal yn gynt. Rydym eisoes yn rhoi'r dull hwn ar waith. Bydd yr hyb orthopedig ranbarthol gwerth £121 miliwn yn Llantrisant yn darparu chwe theatr a 54 o welyau, a disgwylir iddo gynnal tua 3,000 o lawdriniaethau y flwyddyn. Bwrdd Iechyd Prifysgol Aneurin Bevan yw un o'r tri bwrdd iechyd sy'n cydweithio ar y prosiect.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Welsh Government works with Digital Health and Care Wales and all NHS bodies to protect digital infrastructure and patient data. National monitoring, independent assurance, clear legal duties, incident response and improvement plans support a defend-as-one approach, while continued investment strengthens resilience, workforce capability and accountability across NHS Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae Llywodraeth Cymru'n gweithio gyda Iechyd a Gofal Digidol Cymru a holl gyrff y GIG i ddiogelu seilwaith digidol a data cleifion. Mae monitro cenedlaethol, sicrwydd annibynnol, dyletswyddau cyfreithiol clir, ymateb i ddigwyddiadau a chynlluniau gwella yn cefnogi dull 'amddiffyniad unedig' o weithredu, tra bod buddsoddi parhaus yn cryfhau gwydnwch, gallu'r gweithlu ac atebolrwydd ar draws GIG Cymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Llywydd (Huw Irranca-Davies) took the Chair.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you. Cabinet Minister, Wales's NHS is totally dependent on Microsoft's cloud-based services, and so are the rest of our Government's departments. Put simply, this means that the operations of our NHS could be switched off with the flick of a switch, causing chaos. In today's uncertain world, the need for resilient digital systems and infrastructure is greater than ever. 

The European Commission recently adopted the technological sovereignty package, a set of strategic measures to reduce dependency on non-European tech suppliers and to invest in open-source software, strengthening digital autonomy, sovereignty and ownership. Several states and regional administrations across Europe are already moving to open-source and locally hosted solutions. Can the Cabinet Minister make a statement on how the Welsh Government will improve our NHS digital resilience and on safeguarding controls of Welsh systems data, ensuring that our NHS cannot ever be held to ransom and to maintain the ownership of all the systems data in Wales where it belongs?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Weinidog. Weinidog Cabinet, mae GIG Cymru yn hollol ddibynnol ar wasanaethau cwmwl Microsoft, ac felly hefyd gweddill adrannau ein Llywodraeth. Yn syml, mae hyn yn golygu y gellid diffodd gweithrediadau ein GIG ar amrantiad, gan achosi anhrefn, yn amlwg. Yn y byd ansicr sydd ohoni, mae'r angen am systemau a seilwaith digidol gwydn yn fwy nag erioed.

Yn ddiweddar, mabwysiadodd y Comisiwn Ewropeaidd y pecyn sofraniaeth dechnolegol, set o fesurau strategol i leihau dibyniaeth ar gyflenwyr technoleg nad ydynt yn Ewropeaidd ac i fuddsoddi mewn meddalwedd ffynhonnell agored, gan gryfhau ymreolaeth, sofraniaeth a pherchnogaeth ddigidol. Mae sawl gwladwriaeth a gweinyddiaeth ranbarthol ledled Ewrop eisoes yn symud tuag at atebion ffynhonnell agored a lleol. A all y Gweinidog Cabinet wneud datganiad ar sut y bydd Llywodraeth Cymru’n gwella gwydnwch digidol ein GIG ac ar ddiogelu mesurau rheoli data systemau Cymru, gan sicrhau na ellir byth ddal ein GIG yn wystl ac i gynnal perchnogaeth ar yr holl ddata systemau yng Nghymru lle mae'n perthyn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dirprwy Lywydd—. Oh, Llywydd, sorry. I put my head down for two minutes and everything changes. Llywydd, the national data resource, managed by Digital Health and Care Wales, uses the Google Cloud platform to store data, following an open-market procurement exercise. This arrangement takes place under strict contractual arrangements where the NHS remains the owner of the data. The overarching development, deployment and delivery of the NDR platform doesn't inherently lock organisations into Google as a cloud provider. Standards used to manage data such as Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources, FHIR, are open standards, not Google proprietary formats, so data stored are portable by definition. However, the Member's example of what's done with open-source solutions in Europe is interesting, and I'd be interested to keep this conversation going as we look to develop our plans and resources.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ddirprwy Lywydd—o, Lywydd, mae'n ddrwg gennyf. Rwy'n plygu pen am ddwy funud ac mae popeth yn newid. Lywydd, mae'r rhaglen adnoddau data cenedlaethol a reolir gan Iechyd a Gofal Digidol Cymru yn defnyddio platfform Google Cloud i storio data, yn dilyn proses gaffael marchnad agored. Mae'r trefniant hwn yn gweithredu o dan amodau contract llym lle mae'r GIG yn parhau i fod yn berchennog ar y data. Nid yw'r broses drosfwaol o ddatblygu, defnyddio a chyflwyno platfform y rhaglen adnoddau data cenedlaethol yn ei hanfod yn rhwymo sefydliadau i Google fel darparwr cwmwl. Mae'r safonau a ddefnyddir i reoli data, megis adnoddau rhyngweithredu gofal iechyd cyflym (FHIR), yn safonau agored ac nid yn fformatau perchnogol Google, felly, mae'r data sy'n cael ei storio yn gludadwy yn ôl ei ddiffiniad. Fodd bynnag, mae enghraifft yr Aelod o'r hyn sy'n cael ei wneud gyda datrysiadau ffynhonnell agored yn Ewrop yn ddiddorol, a hoffwn barhau â'r sgwrs hon wrth inni edrych ar ddatblygu ein cynlluniau a'n hadnoddau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da. Rydyn ni'n credu y dylai cartrefi fodloni'r safonau disgwyliedig, fod yn ddiogel ac o ansawdd da ar y diwrnod y mae unigolion neu deuluoedd yn symud i'w cartref newydd. Rhaid i berchnogion tai allu cael mynediad at drefniadau effeithiol a syml. Os oes angen datrys problem, rhaid i ddatblygwyr, darparwyr gwarant, asiantau rheoli a chwmnïau rheoli i gyd chwarae eu rhan i fod yn atebol am eu gwasanaethau.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Good afternoon. We believe that homes should meet expected standards, be safe and of good quality on the day individuals or families move into their new home. Home owners must have access to effective and straightforward redress. When action is required to remedy an issue, developers, warranty providers, managing agents and management companies must all play their part in being accountable for their services.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. Cabinet Minister, I was delighted to hear your announcement two weeks ago, including the launch of the Wales interim measures alarm grant and your commitment to holding negligent developers to account. Two weeks ago, I met with Swansea Point Owners and Residents Association, an incredibly inspiring Swansea residents association, who are fighting tooth and nail to get justice for those living in fire-unsafe buildings. Holding negligent developers to account is a tough battle. We expect them to delay, defend and deny at every opportunity possible. What makes this tougher again is, from my understanding, an inadequate fire safety legal landscape that we've inherited from the previous Labour Government—one full of loopholes, exceptions and edge cases, making it easier for developers to evade justice. Cabinet Minister, would you please state how you're going to make sure that developers do not evade accountability and that the victims of fire-unsafe buildings get the justice they deserve as soon as possible?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Weinidog Cabinet, roeddwn wrth fy modd yn clywed eich cyhoeddiad bythefnos yn ôl, gan gynnwys lansio grant larymau mesur interim Cymru, a'ch ymrwymiad i ddwyn datblygwyr esgeulus i gyfrif. Bythefnos yn ôl, cyfarfûm â Chymdeithas Perchnogion a Phreswylwyr Swansea Point, cymdeithas breswylwyr hynod ysbrydoledig yn Abertawe, sy'n ymladd yn galed i gael cyfiawnder i'r rhai sy'n byw mewn adeiladau sy'n anniogel rhag tân. Mae dwyn datblygwyr esgeulus i gyfrif yn frwydr galed. Rydym yn disgwyl iddynt oedi, amddiffyn a gwadu ar bob cyfle posibl. Yr hyn sy'n gwneud hyn yn anos eto, o'r hyn rwy’n ei ddeall, yw’r dirwedd gyfreithiol annigonol mewn perthynas â diogelwch tân a etifeddwyd gan y Llywodraeth Lafur flaenorol—un yn llawn bylchau, eithriadau ac achosion ymylol, gan ei gwneud hi'n haws i ddatblygwyr osgoi cyfiawnder. Weinidog Cabinet, a wnewch chi nodi sut rydych chi'n mynd i sicrhau nad yw datblygwyr yn osgoi atebolrwydd a bod dioddefwyr adeiladau sy'n anniogel rhag tân yn cael y cyfiawnder y maent yn ei haeddu cyn gynted â phosibl?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch yn fawr am dynnu sylw at y mater pwysig yma. Hoffwn i ymuno efo chi yn canmol cymdeithas trigolion Swansea Point. Mi ges i'r pleser o gwrdd ag un o'u cynrychiolwyr nhw bythefnos yn ôl, a dwi'n cofio yn glir ei ddisgrifiad o o'r straen a'r sefyllfa hynod rwystredig mae lesddeiliaid Swansea Point wedi profi ers rhagor na 18 mis. Diolch hefyd am groesawu grant larymau mesur interim Cymru. Roeddwn i'n falch o allu cynnig rhywfaint o gysur o leiaf i'r cynrychiolydd o Swansea Point a ddaeth i mewn i'n gweld ni—rhywfaint o gysur iddo fo a lesddeiliaid eraill Swansea Point a rheini ledled Cymru sy'n wynebu biliau echrydus am fesurau interim tra bod gwaith cyweirio rhag tân yn cael ei wneud. Mae'r grant ar agor i geisiadau, felly dwi'n annog pobl i edrych ar hynny.

O ran eich cwestiwn pwysig am atebolrwydd datblygwyr yn yr holl faes diogelwch adeiladau, mi wnes i gwrdd efo nhw i gyd, yr holl ddatblygwyr sydd wedi arwyddo contract Llywodraeth Cymru. Mi wnes i gyfarfod â nhw bythefnos yn ôl. Roeddwn i'n hollol glir efo nhw yn y cyfarfod yna bod angen cyflymu'r gwaith cyweirio. Mi wnes i eu rhybuddio nhw yn y cyfarfod hwnnw y byddwn i'n rhoi adroddiad cynnydd i chi yma yn y Senedd yn y flwyddyn newydd. Dwi'n edrych ymlaen at gael yr adroddiad cynnydd yna. Mi fydda i'n fwy na pharod i enwi unrhyw ddatblygwyr sydd ddim yn gwneud eu dyletswydd i gyweirio yn unol â'r contract, yn unol â'r disgwyliad bod y gwaith yn dechrau cyn diwedd y flwyddyn yma. Os nad ydyn nhw wedi cyrraedd y sefyllfa yna, mi fydd yn rhaid i fi enwi pobl yn y Siambr yn fan hyn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you very much for highlighting this important issue. I would like to join you in praising the Swansea Point residents association. I had the pleasure of meeting one of their representatives a fortnight ago and I clearly remember his description of the stress and huge frustration that Swansea Point leaseholders have experienced over a period of more than 18 months. Thank you also for welcoming the Wales interim measures alarm grant. I was pleased to be able to provide some comfort to the representative of Swansea Point who came to see us—some comfort for him and other leaseholders in Swansea Point and those across Wales who are facing appallingly high bills for interim measures while remediation work is done. The grant is open for application, so I would encourage people to look at that.

In terms of your important question on the accountability of developers in this whole area of building safety, I did meet them all, all of the developers who have signed the Welsh Government contract. I met them a fortnight ago. I was entirely clear with them in that meeting that we needed to accelerate the remediation work. I warned them at that meeting that I would provide a progress report to you here in the Senedd in the new year. I look forward to receiving that progress report. I will be more than willing to name any developers who aren't acting under their duties to remediate in accordance with the expectation of the contract, and the expectation that the work should start before the end of this year. If they haven't reached that position, then I will have to name people in this Chamber.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Carmarthenshire's revised development plan allocates nearly 9,000 new homes within the county, and those new homes are needed and welcomed. However, the infrastructure to support them just does not keep pace. Glangwili is about to take on specialist critical care for the whole Hywel Dda area and people cannot see a GP or an NHS dentist. So, my question is: what can the Welsh Government or the local planning authority employ to ensure local infrastructure keeps pace with development? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae cynllun datblygu diwygiedig sir Gaerfyrddin yn dyrannu bron i 9,000 o gartrefi newydd yn y sir, ac mae angen y cartrefi newydd hynny ac maent i’w croesawu. Fodd bynnag, nid yw'r seilwaith i'w cefnogi yn digwydd yn ddigon cyflym. Mae Glangwili ar fin ysgwyddo'r cyfrifoldeb am ofal critigol arbenigol ar gyfer ardal gyfan Hywel Dda, ac ni all pobl weld meddyg teulu na deintydd GIG. Felly, fy nghwestiwn i yw hwn: pa fesurau y gall Llywodraeth Cymru neu'r awdurdod cynllunio lleol eu defnyddio i sicrhau bod y seilwaith lleol yn digwydd ar yr un cyflymder â datblygiadau? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Dydw i ddim yn gyfarwydd â'r enghraifft benodol yna, ond mae 'Polisi Cynllunio Cymru' yn nodi y dylai awdurdodau cynllunio lleol gynllunio ar gyfer darparu'r seilwaith sydd ei angen i ddiwallu anghenion cymunedau pan fydd datblygiadau tai newydd yn cael eu hystyried. Felly, mae hi yn ofyniad ar awdurdodau lleol i edrych ar y seilwaith. Mae seilwaith digonol ac effeithlon, gan gynnwys y mathau o bethau rydych chi'n sôn amdanyn nhw, yn hanfodol i ddarparu datblygiadau tai newydd sydd yn diwallu'r anghenion ar gyfer y preswylwyr presennol, a hefyd i'r dyfodol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much. I'm not familiar with that specific example, but 'Planning Policy Wales' does set out that local planning authorities should plan for the infrastructure needed to meet the needs of communities when new housing developments are considered. So, it is a requirement for local authorities to look at the infrastructure. Adequate and efficient infrastructure, including the types of things that you have mentioned, is crucial in providing new housing developments that meet the needs of current and future residents.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Residents of Coed Dyffryn and Tir Founder Fields in Cwmbach finally celebrated last month as their estate was adopted by the local council. It took a whopping 15 years for the developer, Persimmon, to bring the estate up to an adoptable standard, something that I've been campaigning for and working with RCT council to deliver since I was first elected in 2016.

I was also able, through very persistent badgering, to get the same developer, Persimmon, to carry out the works so two estates in Hirwaun could be adopted in the last Senedd term, nearly 20 years after being built. I'm now working on Persimmon estates in Church Village, Mountain Ash, Pontyclun and Llantrisant, the last of which was built a quarter of a century ago.

Cabinet Minister, it's just not acceptable for developers to leave estates unadopted, particularly some of the big four developers who make multimillion-pound profits, whilst they move on to make money with additional projects. Can this new Government make looking at how they can remedy this a priority?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Fe wnaeth trigolion Coed Dyffryn a Tir Founder Fields yng Nghwm-bach ddathlu o'r diwedd fis diwethaf wrth i'w hystad gael ei mabwysiadu gan y cyngor lleol. Cymerodd 15 mlynedd i'r datblygwr, Persimmon, ddatblygu’r ystad i safon addas i'w mabwysiadu, rhywbeth y bûm yn ymgyrchu drosto ac yn gweithio gyda chyngor RhCT i'w gyflawni ers imi gael fy ethol am y tro cyntaf yn 2016.

Hefyd, trwy bwyso’n ddi-baid, llwyddais i gael yr un datblygwr, Persimmon, i wneud y gwaith fel y gellid mabwysiadu dwy ystad yn Hirwaun yn nhymor diwethaf y Senedd, bron i 20 mlynedd ar ôl iddynt gael eu hadeiladu. Rwy'n gweithio nawr ar ystadau Persimmon ym Mhentre’r Eglwys, Aberpennar, Pont-y-clun a Llantrisant. Adeiladwyd yr olaf o’r rhain chwarter canrif yn ôl.

Weinidog Cabinet, nid yw'n dderbyniol o gwbl fod datblygwyr yn gadael ystadau heb eu mabwysiadu, yn enwedig y pedwar datblygwr mawr sy'n gwneud elw o filiynau lawer o bunnoedd, tra'u bod nhw'n symud ymlaen i wneud arian gyda phrosiectau pellach. A all y Llywodraeth newydd roi blaenoriaeth i ystyried sut y gellir unioni hyn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn am y cwestiwn yna a diolch yn fawr iawn i chi am y gwaith rydych chi'n ei wneud ac yn parhau i wneud yn eich etholaeth chi. Dwi'n gyfarwydd, fel Aelod lleol, â'r math yma o sefyllfa hefyd, o ran y datblygiadau yma ddim yn cael eu cwblhau'n briodol, ac yn enwedig y mater yma o lonydd ddim yn cael eu mabwysiadu'n iawn a'r gwaith ddim yn cael ei orffen ar amser, ac weithiau ddim yn cael ei orffen i'r safon angenrheidiol chwaith. Mae'r Llywodraeth yma yn awyddus iawn i weithio efo chi ac efo Aelodau eraill i geisio mynd i'r afael â'r broblem yma. Yn sicr, mi fyddwn i'n hoffi cael sgwrs efo chi ymhellach, i weld os oes gennych chi syniadau penodol ynglŷn â sut i gael y maen i'r wal yn gynt yn yr achosion yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much for that question, and thank you very much to you for the work that you have done and continue to do in your constituency. I'm familiar, as a local Member, with this kind of scenario too, in terms of these developments not being appropriately completed, and particularly this issue of roads not being properly adopted and the work not being completed on time, and sometimes not being completed to the required standards either. This Government is very eager to work with you and other Members in order to try and address this problem. Certainly, I would like to have a further conversation with you, to see if you have any specific ideas as to how we achieve our objectives more quickly in this area.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am y cwestiwn. Rydyn ni’n cefnogi aelwydydd ledled Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr i wella perfformiad eu cartrefi o ran ynni, gwella safonau byw, mynd i'r afael â thlodi tanwydd a lleihau allyriadau carbon. Dwi wedi dyrannu £17 miliwn o gyllid ychwanegol yn ystod y flwyddyn yma i hybu hyn ledled Cymru, gan gynnwys o leiaf £1.6 miliwn o fuddsoddiad yn eich etholaeth chi.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the question. We are supporting households across Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr to improve their home's performance in terms of energy, to improve living standards, to tackle fuel poverty and to reduce carbon emissions. I have allocated £17 million of additional in-year funding to boost delivery of this across Wales, including an investment of at least £1.6 million in your constituency.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Weinidog Cabinet. Rwy'n croesawu ymrwymiad Llywodraeth Cymru ynghylch cartrefi cynnes ac effeithlonrwydd ynni. Gwyddom fod cartref cynnes, diogel a fforddiadwy yn sylfaenol i fywyd iach a hapus, ac eto mae tlodi tanwydd yn parhau i fod yn her sylweddol mewn cymunedau ledled Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr. Mae cyngor Rhondda Cynon Taf wedi nodi bod tua 65 y cant o gartrefi yn ynni aneffeithlon, sy'n adlewyrchu'r stoc dai hŷn yn yr ardal, tra bod tlodi tanwydd yn parhau i effeithio'n anghymesur ar deuluoedd incwm isel, pobl anabl a phreswylwyr hŷn. Sut y bydd cynlluniau Llywodraeth Cymru o fudd i aelwydydd ym Mhontypridd Cynon Merthyr yn benodol? A pha gamau sy'n cael eu cymryd i sicrhau y bydd y gwaith o wella effeithlonrwydd ynni yn helpu i ostwng biliau ynni, gwella iechyd a lles pobl a sicrhau gostyngiad parhaol mewn tlodi tanwydd? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Cabinet Minister. I welcome the Welsh Government's commitment regarding warm homes and energy efficiency. We know that a warm, safe and affordable home is fundamental to a healthy and happy life, yet fuel poverty remains a significant challenge in communities throughout Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr. Rhondda Cynon Taf council has noted that around 65 per cent of homes are energy inefficient, which reflects the area's older housing stock, while fuel poverty continues to disproportionately affect low-income families, disabled people and older residents. How will the Welsh Government's plans benefit residents in Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr? And what action is being taken to ensure that work to improve energy efficiency will help to reduce bills, improve people's health and well-being and ensure a permanent reduction in fuel poverty? Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch yn fawr iawn am amlinellu mwy am eich cwestiwn yn y fanna. Tra bod rhai o'r cynlluniau sydd yn bodoli'n barod wedi dod â rhai deilliannau positif—rydym ni i gyd yn gwybod am rai enghreifftiau da lle mae cynlluniau ynni effeithiol wedi creu gwahaniaeth mawr ac wedi llwyddo i ddod â biliau i lawr i bobl—mae yna lot mwy i wneud, ac mae yna ormod o dai yn parhau i fod yn aneffeithiol ac felly efo biliau sydd yn llawer iawn rhy uchel. Mewn argyfwng costau byw, mae'n hollbwysig ein bod ni'n rhoi sylw penodol i hynny i gyd.

Ar hyn o bryd, efallai nad ydy pobl yn hollol siŵr pa ddulliau o wella effeithlonrwydd yn eu cartrefi nhw sydd orau ar gyfer eu cartrefi nhw. Dŷn nhw ddim yn gwybod lle i fynd i gael cyllid na pha gontractwyr i ddefnyddio yn lleol chwaith. Ond dwi yn benderfynol o gael gwared ar y rhwystrau yma, fel bod pobl yn teimlo eu bod nhw'n hyderus i fedru buddsoddi mewn uwchraddio eu cartrefi i fod yn llawer mwy effeithiol o ran ynni, tra hefyd, wrth gwrs, mae yna gynlluniau ar gyfer cartrefi sydd ar incwm isel. Mae cartrefi Nyth, Nest, wedi profi'n llwyddiannus yn hynny o beth. Ond dŷch chi'n sôn am ehangu, onid ydych, i mewn i gynlluniau ar draws ardaloedd ac ar draws gwahanol denantiaethau, ac mae hwnna'n ganolog i'r gwaith dŷn ni'n ei ddatblygu rŵan o fewn y Llywodraeth. A dwi'n awyddus i'r broses orau oll ar gyfer cymunedau gael ei rhoi ar waith, a dyna pam y byddaf yn gweithio—wel, dwi yn ar hyn o bryd—efo partneriaid i fod yn meddwl ymlaen am y rhaglen sydd angen dod ymlaen.

Roeddwn i'n sôn am fuddsoddiad newydd, ac yn rhan o'r buddsoddiad newydd, mae yna £4 miliwn wedi cael ei neilltuo i gefnogi cynlluniau peilot, sydd yn edrych ar fodelau ar sail ardal. Ac mae yna un yng Nghaerdydd ar hyn o bryd yn symud ymlaen. Mae ceisiadau ar agor ar gyfer y cynllun peilot yma i awdurdodau lleol, landlordiaid cymdeithasol a chyrff llywodraethu rhanbarthol. Mae'r pot yna o arian ar agor tan 14 Hydref, a dwi'n annog unrhyw sefydliad cymwys i wneud cais i gymryd rhan yn y peilot yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you very much for outlining more about your question. While some of the existing plans have brought some positive outcomes—we are all aware of some good examples of where energy efficiency plans and programmes have made a very real difference and have brought people's bills down—there is still much more to be done, and there are too many homes that continue to be energy inefficient, and therefore are paying bills that are far too high. In a cost-of-living crisis, it is crucial that we give particular attention to all of those issues.

At the moment, perhaps people aren't entirely sure what energy-efficiency improvements are best for their homes. They don't know where to access funding and they don't know which contractors they should use locally either. But I am determined to remove those barriers, so that people do feel confident to invest in upgrading their homes so that they are far more energy efficient, whilst also, of course, there are plans for low-income households. The Nest programme has proved to be very successful in that regard. But you are talking about expanding that into plans across whole areas and across different tenancies, and that is central to the work that we are now developing within Government. And I am eager to get the best possible process for communities and to see that being implemented, and that's why I will be working, and I'm currently working, with partners to think ahead in terms of the programme that we need to develop.

I mentioned new investment, and as part of that new investment, £4 million has been allocated to support pilot schemes that are looking at area-based models. And there is one in Cardiff at the moment, and that is progressing. Applications are available for this pilot scheme for local authorities, social landlords and regional governing bodies. That pot of funding is open until 14 October, and I would encourage any qualifying organisation to make an application to be involved in that pilot.
